summary.text: Dan Sullivan, a Republican from Jonesboro, represents Arkansas Senate District 20, which includes parts of Craighead County and the cities of Jonesboro and Bono and Herndon Township.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Senate in November 2020 and sworn in on the first day of the 2021 regular session, after six years in the Arkansas House of Representatives.
Sullivan earned a BSE from Arkansas State University and an MSE in school administration from Northeast Missouri State.
He is retired from the healthcare industry and is a former administrator of the Jonesboro School System.
